scope: Deterministic generator/validator, palette boundaries, seeded world/town/herd roundtrips, breeding, market, countries, quests, contracts, victories, fault injection. Not a proof for every save or mobile runtime.
source_save_policy: Only isolated synthetic test files. No user save changed or deleted. Cosmetic recovery is memory-only and disk writes remain blocked.
visual: 1280x720 desktop rendering inspected: recovery notice and read-only diagnostic, no clipped text. Not Android touch QA.
known_limitations: No exhaustive full-game suite run. Some existing test scripts delete files and were deliberately excluded.
Unknown genetic finishes, earned emblems and reward-bearing fields remain strict, no automatic default.
Existing normalizing readers outside the explicitly hardened fields are not certified lossless.
Transient I/O failure tests cover temporary-write failure, not power-loss, full disk or every OS rename condition.
No automatic on-disk repair or separate recovery file. Needs owner approval.
